profile.headline: Senior Software Developer | Java, Spring, React & SQL | AWS Cloud Implementation, Application Modernization & DevOps
profile.summary:
Software developer with more than 25 years of experience spanning mainframe, Java, web, integration, and cloud-based application environments.
Currently contributing to the modernization of a COBOL/JCL system into a Java application hosted in AWS, including remediation of converted code, development of new full-stack functionality, and targeted updates to AWS infrastructure and infrastructure-as-code configurations.
Experienced in enterprise application development, legacy-system modernization, troubleshooting, and implementing solutions within established architectures.
Interested in opportunities that combine software development with AWS cloud implementation, deployment, automation, and DevOps practices.

positions.title: Software Engineer IV
positions.description:
Supported two U.S. Air Force projects: HRSTS III and Air Force SCS Modernization.

Air Force SCS Modernization, 04/2025 - Present
• Review, debug, and remediate Java code produced through the automated conversion of the Air Force Stock Control System from COBOL/JCL to a cloud-based Java architecture hosted in AWS.
• Designed and developed a new full-stack administrative console, including the database structure, React front end, and Java/Spring back-end services, enabling the project to replace functionality previously provided by a third party with an in-house solution.
• Analyze converted code, existing mainframe functionality, and business requirements to identify and correct conversion defects while preserving expected system behavior.
• Modify and maintain application components using Java, Spring, SQL, MySQL, and React within the project’s established modernization architecture.
• Investigate application issues and implement corrections using IntelliJ, Oracle SQL Developer, Checkmarx, and AWS-based development and deployment environments.
• Collaborate with team members to validate converted functionality and integrate corrected components into the modernized system.

Technologies: Java, Spring, SQL, MySQL, React, AWS, EC2, ECS, Lambda, CloudFormation, CodePipeline, IntelliJ, Oracle SQL Developer, Checkmarx

HRSTS III, 01/2024 - 04/2025
• Developed Air Force service-oriented applications that exposed personnel and human-resources data to downstream consumers.
• Collaborated with internal and external team members to implement functionality for the Air Force Personnel Center.

Technologies: Java, Spring, SQL, MySQL, AWS, EC2, ECS, Lambda, XML, XSD, WSDL, IntelliJ, Rational Application Developer for WebSphere, ReadyAPI, IIB Integration Toolkit, MQ Explorer, Oracle SQL Developer, Linux, PuTTY, Jira, Checkmarx, AFPC 4.0, Jenkins, Apache Ant, Groovy, Bitbucket, JFrog Artifactory

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Served as the sole domestic mainframe programmer and project lead, leading an offshore team in Hyderabad, India, to integrate new web-based products with new and existing mainframe functionality.
• Collaborated closely with web development teams to design and build new interfaces and enhance existing interfaces.
• Designed, developed, and implemented processes in the mainframe environment.
• Coordinated with database administrators to design new DB2 tables, including table layouts and referential-integrity relationships.

Technologies: COBOL, CICS, JCL, DB2, SQL, Eztrieve, Endevor, ESP, XML

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
• Designed, developed, and implemented solutions on mainframe platforms.
• Updated internal client websites to reflect current client information.
• Participated in a major company initiative to convert database tables to DB2, including planning table layouts and referential-integrity relationships and identifying hundreds of programs requiring updates for each conversion.
• Coordinated with an offshore team of 40 associates in Bangkok, Thailand, throughout all phases of the database-conversion process.
• Developed and enhanced a purge process that deleted data related to closed funds across more than 50 tables and served as subject matter expert, helping client teams configure and use the process.
• Volunteered to work with offshore associates in Bangkok to strengthen professional relationships, communication, and project efficiency.

Technologies: COBOL, CICS, JCL, DB2, SQL, Eztrieve, Endevor, ESP, HTML, CSS

projects.title: AWS Cloud Infrastructure Reference Project
projects.description: Built a reproducible AWS reference environment demonstrating infrastructure provisioning and application deployment using both Terraform and AWS CloudFormation. Implemented alternative EC2 and ECS/Fargate deployment architectures for a Spring Boot application, incorporating AWS networking, RDS, S3, IAM, SSM Parameter Store, CloudWatch, and deployment automation. Designed the environment for repeatable deployment and teardown while documenting architectural decisions, operational validation, and implementation tradeoffs.
